verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጐንደየ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወሪደ ፡ እምደብር ፡ ተንሥአ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወይቤልዎ
                  ፡ ተንሥእ ፡ ወግበር ፡ ለነ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ እለ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ ቅድሜነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዘአውፅአነ ፡
                  እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ኢናአምር ፡ ምንተ ፡ ኮነ ።
verses.translation: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people combined against Aaron, and said to him, Arise and make us gods who shall go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us forth out of the land of Egypt—we do not know what is become of him.

translations.lxx: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people combined against Aaron, and said to him, Arise and make us gods who shall go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us forth out of the land of Egypt—we do not know what is become of him.
translations.kjv: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
translations.ron: Văzând însă poporul că Moise întârzie a se pogorî din munte, s-a adunat la Aaron şi i-a zis: "Scoală şi ne fă dumnezei, care să meargă înaintea noastră, căci cu omul acesta, cu Moise, care ne-a scos din ţara Egiptului, nu ştim ce s-a întâmplat".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἰδὼν ὁ λαὸς, ὅτι κεχρόνικε Μωυσῆς καταβῆναι ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους, συνέστη ὁ λαὸς ἐπὶ Ἀαρὼν, καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ἀνάστηθι, καὶ ποίησον ἡμῖν θεοὺς, οἳ προπορεύσονται ἡμῶν· ὁ γὰρ Μωυσῆς οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί γέγονεν αὐτῷ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ አሮን ፡ ንሥኡ ፡ ሰርጐ ፡ [ወርቅ ፡] ዘውስተ ፡ እዝነ ፡ አንስቲያክሙ ፡ ወአዋልዲክሙ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ ኀቤየ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Aaron says to them, Take off the golden ear-rings which are in the ears of your wives and daughters, and bring them to me.

translations.lxx: And Aaron says to them, Take off the golden ear-rings which are in the ears of your wives and daughters, and bring them to me.
translations.kjv: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
translations.ron: Iar Aaron le-a zis: "Scoateţi cerceii de aur din urechile femeilor voastre, ale feciorilor voştri şi ale fetelor voastre şi-i aduceţi la mine".
translations.grk: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἀαρὼν Περιέλεσθε τὰ ἐνώτια τὰ χρυσᾶ τὰ ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶ τῶν γυναικῶν ὑμῶν καὶ θυγατέρων, καὶ ἐνέγκατε πρός με.

verses.geez: ወነሥኡ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ሰርጐ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ አእዛኒሆሙ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አሮን ።
verses.translation: And all the people took off the golden ear-rings that were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

translations.lxx: And all the people took off the golden ear-rings that were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
translations.kjv: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
translations.ron: Atunci tot poporul a scos cerceii cei de aur din urechile alor săi şi i-a adus la Aaron.
translations.grk: Καὶ περιείλαντο πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τὰ ἐνώτια τὰ χρυσᾶ τὰ ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἤνεγκαν πρὸς Ἀαρών.

verses.geez:
ወተመጠወ ፡ እምእደዊሆሙ ፡ ወመሰሎ ፡ በሥዕል ፡ ወገብሮ ፡ ላህመ ፡ ስብኮ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ አማልክቲከ ፡
                  እስራኤል ፡ እለ ፡ አውፅኡከ ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And he received them at their hands, and formed them with a graving tool; and he made them a molten calf, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

translations.lxx: And he received them at their hands, and formed them with a graving tool; and he made them a molten calf, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
translations.ron: Luându-i din mâinile lor, i-a turnat în tipar şi a făcut din ei un viţel turnat şi l-a cioplit cu dalta. Iar ei au zis: "Iată, Israele, dumnezeul tău, care te-a scos din ţara Egiptului!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐδέξατο ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔπλασεν αὐτὰ ἐν τῇ γραφίδι· καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτὰ μόσχον χωνευτὸν καὶ εἶπεν, Οὗτοι οἱ θεοί σου Ἰσραὴλ, οἵτινες ἀνεβίβασάν σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ ኤሮን ፡ ነደቀ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ አንጻሮ ፡ ወአዖደ ፡ አሮን ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ በዓለ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ ጌሠመ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Aaron having seen it built an altar before it, and Aaron made proclamation saying, To-morrow is a feast of the Lord.

translations.lxx: And Aaron having seen it built an altar before it, and Aaron made proclamation saying, To-morrow is a feast of the Lord.
translations.kjv: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD.
translations.ron: Văzând aceasta, Aaron a zidit înaintea lui un jertfelnic; şi a strigat Aaron şi a zis: "Mâine este sărbătoarea Domnului!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἰδὼν Ἀαρὼν ᾠκοδόμησε θυσιαστήριον κατέναντι αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐκήρυξεν Ἀαρὼν λέγων, ἑορτὴ τοῦ κυρίου αὔριον.

verses.geez:
ወጌሠ ፡ አሮን ፡ በሳኒታ ፡ ወአዕረገ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ወአብአ ፡ ቍርባነ ፡ ዘመሥዋዕተ ፡ ፍርቃን ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡
                  ወይበልዑ ፡ ወይሰትዩ ፡ ወተንሥኡ ፡ ይትወነዩ ።
verses.translation: And having risen early on the morrow, he offered whole burnt-offerings, and offered a peace-offering; and the people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

translations.lxx: And having risen early on the morrow, he offered whole burnt-offerings, and offered a peace-offering; and the people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
translations.kjv: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
translations.ron: A doua zi s-au sculat ei de dimineaţă şi au adus arderi de tot şi jertfe de pace; apoi a şezut poporul de a mâncat şi a băut şi pe urmă s-a sculat şi a jucat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὀρθρίσας τῇ ἐπαύριον ἀνεβίβασεν ὁλοκαυτώματα, καὶ προσήνεγκε θυσίαν σωτηρίου· καὶ ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν.

verses.geez:
ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ሑር ፡ ወአፍጥን ፡ ወሪደ ፡ እምዝየ ፡ እስመ ፡ አበሱ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡
                  ዘአውፃእከ ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, Go quickly, descend hence, for thy people whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt have transgressed;

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, Go quickly, descend hence, for thy people whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt have transgressed;
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Domnul către Moise: "Grăbeşte de te pogoară de aici, căci poporul tău, pe care l-ai scos din ţara Egiptului, s-a răzvrătit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων, βάδιζε τὸ τάχος, κατάβηθι ἐντεύθεν· ἠνόμησε γὰρ ὁ λαός σου ὃν ἐξήγαγες ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου.

verses.geez:
ወዐለዉ ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ እንተ ፡ አዘዝካሆሙ ፡ ወገብሩ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ላህመ ፡ ወሰገዱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወሦዑ ፡ ሎቱ
                  ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ አማልክቲከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እለ ፡ አውፅኡከ ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: they have quickly gone out of the way which thou commandedst; they have made for themselves a calf, and worshipped it, and sacrificed to it, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

translations.lxx: they have quickly gone out of the way which thou commandedst; they have made for themselves a calf, and worshipped it, and sacrificed to it, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
translations.ron: Curând s-au abătut de la calea pe care le-am poruncit-o, şi-au făcut un viţel turnat şi s-au închinat la el, aducându-i jertfe şi zicând: "Iată, Israele, dumnezeul tău, care te-a scos din ţara Egiptului!"
translations.grk: Παρέβησαν ταχὺ ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ, ἧς ἐνετείλω αὐτοῖς· ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς μόσχον, καὶ προσκεκυνήκασιν αὐτῷ, καὶ τεθύκασιν αὐτῷ, καὶ εἶπαν, Οὗτοι οἱ θεοί σου Ἰσραὴλ, οἵτινες ἀνεβίβασάν σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ኅድገኒ ፡ ወተምዒዕየ ፡ በመዐትየ ፡ እጥስዮሙ ፡ ወእሬስየከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዐቢይ ።
verses.translation: And now let me alone, and I will be very angry with them and consume them, and I will make thee a great nation.

translations.lxx: And now let me alone, and I will be very angry with them and consume them, and I will make thee a great nation.
translations.kjv: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
translations.ron: Lasă-Mă dar acum să se aprindă mânia Mea asupra lor, să-i pierd şi să fac din tine un popor mare!"
translations.grk: καὶ νῦν ἔασόν με, καὶ θυμωθεὶς ὀργῇ εἰς αὐτοὺς, ἐκτρίψω αὐτούς· καὶ ποιήσω σὲ εἰς ἔθνος μέγα.

verses.geez:
ወሰአለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ለምንት ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ መዐተ ፡ ትትመዓዕ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ ዘአውፃእከ
                  ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ በኀይል ፡ ልዑል ፡ ወበመዝራዕት ፡ ዐቢይ ።
verses.translation: And Moses prayed before the Lord God, and said, Wherefore, O Lord, art thou very angry with thy people, whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt with great strength, and with thy high arm?

translations.lxx: And Moses prayed before the Lord God, and said, Wherefore, O Lord, art thou very angry with thy people, whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt with great strength, and with thy high arm?
translations.kjv: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
translations.ron: Moise însă a rugat pe Domnul Dumnezeul său şi a zis: "Să nu se aprindă, Doamne, mânia Ta asupra poporului Tău, pe care l-ai scos din ţara Egiptului cu putere mare şi cu braţul Tău cel înalt,
translations.grk: καὶ ἐδεήθη Μωυσῆς ἔναντι Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ εἶπεν, ἱνατί, Κύριε, θυμοῖ ὀργῇ εἰς τὸν λαόν σου, οὓς ἐξήγαγες ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐν ἰσχύϊ μεγάλῃ, καὶ ἐν τῷ βραχίονί σου τῷ ὑψηλῷ;

verses.geez:
ከመ ፡ ኢይበሉ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ በእኩይ ፡ ኤውፅኦሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይቅትሎሙ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ወያጥፍኦሙ ፡ እምውስተ ፡
                  ምድር ፡ አቍርር ፡ መዓተከ ፡ ዘተምዕዕከ ፡ ወመሓሬ ፡ ኩን ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እከዮሙ ፡ ለሕዝብከ ።
verses.translation: Take heed lest at any time the Egyptians speak, saying, With evil intent he brought them out to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from off the earth; cease from thy wrathful anger, and be merciful to the sin of thy people,

translations.lxx: Take heed lest at any time the Egyptians speak, saying, With evil intent he brought them out to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from off the earth; cease from thy wrathful anger, and be merciful to the sin of thy people,
translations.kjv: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
translations.ron: Ca nu cumva să zică Egiptenii: I-a dus la pieire, ca să-i ucidă în munţi şi să-i şteargă de pe fala pământului. Întoarce-Ţi iuţimea mâniei Tale, milostiveşte-Te şi nu căuta la răutatea poporului Tău.
translations.grk: Μή ποτε εἴπωσιν οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι λέγοντες Μετὰ πονηρίας ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἀποκτεῖναι ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν καὶ ἐξαναλῶσαι αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς. παῦσαι τῆς ὀργῆς τοῦ θυμοῦ σου, καὶ ἵλεως γενοῦ ἐπὶ τῇ κακίᾳ τοῦ λαοῦ σου,

verses.geez:
ተዘከር ፡ አብርሃምሃ ፡ ወይስሐቅሃ ፡ ወያዕቆብሃ ፡ አግብርቲከ ፡ እለ ፡ መሐልከ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ በርእስከ ፡ ወትቤሎሙ ፡ ብዙኀ
                  ፡ አበዝኆ ፡ ለዘርእክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ከዋክብተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ በብዝኅ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ እሁብ ፡ ለዘርእክሙ ፡ ወይምልክዋ ፡
                  ለዓለም ።
verses.translation: remembering Abraam and Isaac and Jacob thy servants, to whom thou hast sworn by thyself, and hast spoken to them, saying, I will greatly multiply your seed as the stars of heaven for multitude, and all this land which thou spokest of to give to them, so that they shall possess it for ever.

translations.lxx: remembering Abraam and Isaac and Jacob thy servants, to whom thou hast sworn by thyself, and hast spoken to them, saying, I will greatly multiply your seed as the stars of heaven for multitude, and all this land which thou spokest of to give to them, so that they shall possess it for ever.
translations.kjv: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
translations.ron: Adu-ţi aminte de Avraam, de Isaac şi de Iacov, robii Tăi, cărora Te-ai jurat Tu pe Tine Însuţi, zicând: Voi înmulţi foarte tare neamul vostru, ca stelele cerului; şi tot pământul acesta, de care v-am vorbit, îl voi da urmaşilor voştri şi-l vor stăpâni în veci!"
translations.grk: μνησθεὶς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ τῶν σῶν οἰκετῶν, οἷς ὤμοσας κατὰ σεαυτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλησας πρὸς αὐτοὺς, λέγων, πολυπληθυνῶ τὸ σπέρμα ὑμῶν ὡσεὶ τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ πλήθει· καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἣν εἶπας δοῦναι αὐτοῖς, καὶ καθέξουσιν αὐτὴν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

verses.geez: ወሰረየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእንተ ፡ እኪት ፡ እንተ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሕዝቡ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord was prevailed upon to preserve his people.

translations.lxx: And the Lord was prevailed upon to preserve his people.
translations.kjv: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
translations.ron: Atunci a abătut Domnul pieirea ce zisese s-o aducă asupra poporului Său.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἱλάσθη Κύριος περιποιῆσαι τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወተመይጠ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወወረደ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወ፪ጽላተ ፡ ዘትእዛዝ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ጽላት ፡ ዘእብን ፡
                  ጽሑፋት ፡ እንተ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ገበዋቲሆን ፡ እንተ ፡ ለፌኒ ፡ ወእንተ ፡ ለፌኒ ፡ ጽሑፋት ።
verses.translation: And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, and the two tables of testimony were in his hands, tables of stone written on both their sides: they were written within and without.

translations.lxx: And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, and the two tables of testimony were in his hands, tables of stone written on both their sides: they were written within and without.
translations.kjv: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
translations.ron: După aceea Moise, întorcându-se; s-a pogorât din munte, cu cele două table ale legii în mână, scrise pe amândouă părţile lor - pe o parte şi pe alta erau scrise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀποστρέψας Μωυσῆς, κατέβη ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους· καὶ αἱ δύο πλάκες τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ, πλάκες λίθιναι καταγεγραμμέναι ἐξ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν μερῶν αὐτῶν, ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν ἦσανς γεγραμμέναι·

verses.geez: ወጽላቶን ፡ ግብረተ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ እማንቱ ፡ ወጽሕፈቶንሂ ፡ ጽሕፈተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ግሉፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽሌሁ ።
verses.translation: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing the writing of God written on the tables.

translations.lxx: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing the writing of God written on the tables.
translations.kjv: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
translations.ron: Tablele acestea erau lucrul lui Dumnezeu şi scrierea era scrierea lui Dumnezeu, săpată pe table.
translations.grk: καὶ αἱ πλάκες ἔργον Θεοῦ ἦσαν, καὶ ἡ γραφὴ γραφὴ Θεοῦ κεκολαμμένη ἐν ταῖς πλαξί.

verses.geez: ወሰሚዖ ፡ ዮሳዕ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይጸርሑ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ [ድ]ምፀ ፡ ፀባኢት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: And Joshua having heard the voice of the people crying, says to Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

translations.lxx: And Joshua having heard the voice of the people crying, says to Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
translations.kjv: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
translations.ron: Atunci, auzind Iosua glasul poporului răsunând, a zis către Moise: "În tabără se aud strigăte de război".
translations.grk: καὶ ἀκούσας Ἰησοῦς τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ λαοῦ κραζόντων, λέγει πρὸς Μωυσὴν, Φωνὴ πολέμου ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኢኮነ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ድምፅ ፡ ዘመላእክት ፡ እለ ፡ ይትኄየሉ ፡ ወኢኮነ ፡ ድምፀ ፡ መላእክተ ፡ ፀብእ ፡
                  አላ ፡ ድምፀ ፡ መላእክቱ ፡ ለወይን ፡ እሰምዕ ፡ አንሰ ።
verses.translation: And Moses says, It is not the voice of them that begin the battle, nor the voice of them that begin the cry of defeat, but the voice of them that begin the banquet of wine do I hear.

translations.lxx: And Moses says, It is not the voice of them that begin the battle, nor the voice of them that begin the cry of defeat, but the voice of them that begin the banquet of wine do I hear.
translations.kjv: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
translations.ron: Iar Moise a zis: "Acesta nu este glas de biruitori, nici glas de biruiţi; ci eu aud glas de oameni beţi".
translations.grk: καὶ λέγει Οὐκ ἔστι φωνὴ ἐξαρχόντων κατʼ ἰσχὺν, οὐδὲ φωνὴ ἐξαρχόντων τροπῆς, ἀλλὰ φωνὴν ἐξαρχόντων οἴνου ἐγὼ ἀκούω.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ቀርበ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለትዕይንት ፡ ርእዮ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ላህም ፡ ወተውኔት ፡ ወተምዕዐ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወገደፎን ፡ እምውስተ
                  ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ለእልክቱ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላት ፡ ወቀጥቀጦን ፡ በታሕተ ፡ ደብር ።
verses.translation: And when he drew nigh to the camp, he sees the calf and the dances; and Moses being very angry cast the two tables out of his hands, and broke them to pieces under the mountain.

translations.lxx: And when he drew nigh to the camp, he sees the calf and the dances; and Moses being very angry cast the two tables out of his hands, and broke them to pieces under the mountain.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
translations.ron: Iar după ce s-a apropiat de tabără, el a văzut viţelul şi jocurile şi, aprinzându-se de mânie, a aruncat din mâinile sale cele două table şi le-a sfărâmat sub munte.
translations.grk: καὶ ἡνίκα ἤγγιζε τῇ παρεμβολῇ, ὁρᾷ τὸν μόσχον καὶ τοὺς χορούς· καὶ ὀργισθεὶς θυμῷ Μωυσῆς ἔῤῥιψεν ἀπὸ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ τὰς δύο πλάκας, καὶ συνέτριψεν αὐτὰς ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος·

verses.geez:
ወነሥኦ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ላህም ፡ ዘገብሩ ፡ ወአውዐዮ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ወሐረጾ ፡ ወአድቀቆ ፡ ወዘረዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማይ ፡
                  ወአስተዮሙ ፡ ኪያሁ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And having taken the calf which they made, he consumed it with fire, and ground it very small, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel to drink it.

translations.lxx: And having taken the calf which they made, he consumed it with fire, and ground it very small, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel to drink it.
translations.kjv: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
translations.ron: Apoi luând viţelul, pe care-l făcuseră ei, l-a ars în foc, l-a făcut pulbere şi, presărându-l în apă, a dat-o să o bea fiii lui Israel.
translations.grk: καὶ λαβὼν τὸν μόσχον ὃν ἐποίησαν, κατέκαυσεν αὐτὸν ἐν πυρὶ, καὶ κατήλεσεν αὐτὸν λεπτὸν, καὶ ἔσπειρεν αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τὸ ὕδωρ, καὶ ἐπότισεν αὐτὸ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ምንተ ፡ ረሰይከ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታምጽእ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ ዐቢየ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to Aaron, What has this people done to thee, that thou hast brought upon them a great sin?

translations.lxx: And Moses said to Aaron, What has this people done to thee, that thou hast brought upon them a great sin?
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
translations.ron: După aceea a zis către Aaron: "Ce ti-a făcut poporul acesta, de l-ai vârât într-un păcat aşa de mare?"
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς τῷ Ἀαρὼν, Τί ἐποίησέ σοι ὁ λαὸς οὗτος, ὅτι ἐπήγαγες ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ἁμαρτίαν μεγάλην;

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ አሮን ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ኢተትመዓዕ ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ታአምር ፡ ግዕዞሙ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron said to Moses, Be not angry, my lord, for thou knowest the impetuosity of this people.

translations.lxx: And Aaron said to Moses, Be not angry, my lord, for thou knowest the impetuosity of this people.
translations.kjv: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
translations.ron: Iar Aaron a răspuns lui Moise: "Să nu se aprindă mânia domnului meu! Tu ştii pe poporul acesta că e răzvrătitor.
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπεν Ἀαρὼν πρὸς Μωυσῆν, μὴ ὀργίζου, κύριε· σὺ γὰρ οἶδας τὸ ὅρμημα τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου.

verses.geez:
ሶበ ፡ ይቤሉኒ ፡ ግበር ፡ ለነ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ እለ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ ቅድሜነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዘአውፅአነ
                  ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ኢናአምር ፡ ምንተ ፡ ኮነ ፤
verses.translation: For they say to me, Make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this man Moses, who brought us out of Egypt, we do not know what is become of him.

translations.lxx: For they say to me, Make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this man Moses, who brought us out of Egypt, we do not know what is become of him.
translations.kjv: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
translations.ron: Căci ei mi-au zis: Fă-ne dumnezei, care să meargă înaintea noastră, căci cu omul acesta, cu Moise, care ne-a scos din ţara Egiptului, nu ştim ce s-a întâmplat.
translations.grk: Λέγουσι γάρ μοι, ποιήσον ἡμῖν θεοὺς, οἳ προπορεύσονται ἡμῶν· ὁ γὰρ Μωυσῆς οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος, ὃς ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου, οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί γέγονεν αὐτῷ.

verses.geez:
ወእቤሎሙ ፡ ዘቦ ፡ እምኔክሙ ፡ ወርቀ ፡ አምጽኡ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ ወወሀቡኒ ፡ ወወረውክዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እሳት ፡ ወወፅአ ፡
                  ዝንቱ ፡ ላህም ።
verses.translation: And I said to them, If any one has golden ornaments, take them off; and they gave them me, and I cast them into the fire, and there came out this calf.

translations.lxx: And I said to them, If any one has golden ornaments, take them off; and they gave them me, and I cast them into the fire, and there came out this calf.
translations.kjv: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
translations.ron: Atunci eu le-am zis: Cine are aur să-l scoată. Şi ei l-au scos şi mi l-au dat mie şi eu l-am aruncat în foc şi a ieşit acest viţel".
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπα αὐτοῖς, εἴ τινι ὑπάρχει χρυσία, περιέλεσθε· καὶ ἔδωκάν μοι· καὶ ἔῤῥιψα εἰς τὸ πῦρ· καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ μόσχος οὗτος.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዐለዉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወአዕለዎሙ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወኮኑ ፡ ሣሕቀ ፡ ለጸላእቶሙ ፤
verses.translation: And when Moses saw that the people was scattered,—for Aaron had scattered them so as to be a rejoicing to their enemies,—

translations.lxx: And when Moses saw that the people was scattered,—for Aaron had scattered them so as to be a rejoicing to their enemies,—
translations.kjv: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
translations.ron: Moise, văzând că poporul acesta e neînfrânat, căci Aaron îngăduise să ajungă neînfrânat şi de râs înaintea duşmanilor lui,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἰδὼν Μωυσῆς τὸν λαὸν ὅτι διεσκέδασται· (διεσκέδασε γὰρ αὐτοὺς Ἀαρών ἐπίχαρμα τοῖς ὑπεναντίοις αὐτῶν)

verses.geez:
ወቆመ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አንቀጸ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ዘኀርየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይምጻእ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ወተጋብኡ ፡ ኀቤሁ
                  ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሌዊ ።
verses.translation: then stood Moses at the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord's side? let him come to me. Then all the sons of Levi came to him.

translations.lxx: then stood Moses at the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord's side? let him come to me. Then all the sons of Levi came to him.
translations.kjv: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’s side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
translations.ron: A stat la intrarea taberei şi a zis: "Cine este pentru Domnul să vină la mine!" Şi s-au adunat la el toţi fiii lui Levi.
translations.grk: ἔστη δὲ Μωυσῆς ἑπὶ τῆς πύλης τῆς παρεμβολῆς, καὶ εἶπε, τίς πρὸς Κύριον; ἴτω πρός με. Συνῆλθον οὖν πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Λευί.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ይጹር ፡ ሰይፎ ፡ ወብጽሑ ፡
                  እምአንቀጽ ፡ እስከ ፡ አንቀጸ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ወአሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ይቅትል ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ወአሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ይቅትል ፡ ካልኦ ፡
                  ወአሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ይቅትል ፡ ዘቅሩቡ ።
verses.translation: And he says to them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Put every one his sword on his thigh, and go through and return from gate to gate through the camp, and slay every one his brother, and every one his neighbour, and every one him that is nearest to him.

translations.lxx: And he says to them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Put every one his sword on his thigh, and go through and return from gate to gate through the camp, and slay every one his brother, and every one his neighbour, and every one him that is nearest to him.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
translations.ron: Iar Moise le-a zis: "Aşa zice Domnul Dumnezeul lui Israel: Să-şi încingă fiecare din voi sabia sa la şold şi străbătând tabăra de la o intrare până la cealaltă, înainte şi înapoi, să ucidă fiecare pe fratele său, pe prietenul său şi pe aproapele său".
translations.grk: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς τάδε λέγει Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς Ἰσραήλ θέσθε ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ῥομφαίανν ἐπὶ τὸν μηρὸν, καὶ διέλθατε καὶ ἀνακάμψατε ἀπὸ πύλης ἐπὶ πύλην διὰ τῆς παρεμβολῆς, καὶ ἀποκτείνατε ἕκαστος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἕκαστος τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἓκαστος τὸν ἔγγιστα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወወድቀ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ይእተ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ፴፻ብእሲ ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Levi did as Moses spoke to them, and there fell of the people in that day to the number of three thousand men.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Levi did as Moses spoke to them, and there fell of the people in that day to the number of three thousand men.
translations.kjv: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
translations.ron: Şi au făcut fiii lui Levi după cuvântul lui Moise. În ziua aceea au căzut din popor ca la trei mii de oameni.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Λευεὶ καθὰ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς· καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ εἰς τρισχιλίους ἄνδρας.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ አንፈስክምዎ ፡ በእደዊክሙ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዮም ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምኔክሙ ፡ እምውሉዱ ፡
                  ወእምእኁሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትትወሀብ ፡ ላዕሌክሙ ፡ በረከት ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to them, Ye have filled your hands this day to the Lord each one on his son or on his brother, so that blessing should be given to you.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to them, Ye have filled your hands this day to the Lord each one on his son or on his brother, so that blessing should be given to you.
translations.kjv: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
translations.ron: Căci Moise le zisese fiilor lui Levi: "Afierosiţi-vă astăzi mâinile voastre Domnului, fiecare prin fiul său sau prin fratele său, ca să vă trimită El astăzi binecuvântare!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς, ἐπληρώσατε τὰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν σήμερον Κυρίῳ ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ υἱῷ ἢ ἐν τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ, δοθῆναι ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς εὐλογίαν.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ በሳኒታ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ጌገይክሙ ፡ ጌጋየ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ ወይእዜኒ ፡ አዐርግ ፡ ኀበ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ አስተስሪ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ኀጢአተክሙ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass after the morrow had begun, that Moses said to the people, Ye have sinned a great sin; and now I will go up to God, that I may make atonement for your sin.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass after the morrow had begun, that Moses said to the people, Ye have sinned a great sin; and now I will go up to God, that I may make atonement for your sin.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
translations.ron: Iar a doua zi a zis Moise către popor: "Aţi făcut păcat mare; mă voi sui acum la Domnul să văd nu cumva voi şterge păcatul vostru".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὴν αὔριον εἶπε Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν λαὸν, ὑμεῖς ἡμαρτήκατε ἁμαρτίαν μεγάλη· καὶ νῦν ἀναβήσομαι πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν, ἵνα ἐξιλάσωμαι περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወገብአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይቤ ፡ እስእለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አባሲ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ አበሳ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡
                  ወገብሩ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ ዘወርቅ ።
verses.translation: And Moses returned to the Lord and said, I pray, O Lord, this people has sinned a great sin, and they have made for themselves golden gods.

translations.lxx: And Moses returned to the Lord and said, I pray, O Lord, this people has sinned a great sin, and they have made for themselves golden gods.
translations.kjv: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
translations.ron: Şi s-a întors Moise la Domnul şi a zis: "O, Doamne, poporul acesta a săvârşit păcat mare, făcându-şi dumnezeu de aur.
translations.grk: Ὑπέστρεψε δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς Κύριον, καὶ εἶπε, δέομαι, κύριε· ἡμάρτηκεν ὁ λαὸς οὗτος ἁμαρτίαν μεγάλην, καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς θεοὺς χρυσοῦς.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜኒ ፡ እመ ፡ ተኀደግ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ዛተ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ ኅድግ ፡ ወእማእኮ ፡ ደምስስ ፡ ኪያየኒ ፡ እምነ ፡ መጽሐፍከ ፡
                  ዘጸሐፍከኒ ።
verses.translation: And now if thou wilt forgive their sin, forgive it; and if not, blot me out of thy book, which thou hast written.

translations.lxx: And now if thou wilt forgive their sin, forgive it; and if not, blot me out of thy book, which thou hast written.
translations.kjv: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
translations.ron: Rogu-mă acum, de vrei să le ierţi păcatul acesta, iartă-i; iar de nu, şterge-mă şi pe mine din cartea Ta, în care m-ai scris!"
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν εἰ μὲν ἀφεῖς αὐτοῖς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν αὐτῶν, ἄφες· εἰ δὲ μή, ἐξάλειψόν με ἐκ τῆς βίβλου σου, ἧς ἔγραψας.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ለዝክቱ ፡ ዘአበሰ ፡ በቅድሜየ ፡ እደመስሶ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ መጽሐፍየ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, If any one has sinned against me, I will blot them out of my book.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, If any one has sinned against me, I will blot them out of my book.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
translations.ron: Zis-a Domnul către Moise: "Pe acela care a greşit înaintea Mea îl voi şterge din cartea Mea.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, εἴ τις ἡμάρτηκεν ἐνώπιόν μου, ἐξαλείψω αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῆς βίβλου μου.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜኒ ፡ ሑር ፡ ወምርሖሙ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካን ፡ ዘእቤለከ ፡ ናሁ ፡ መልአኪየ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ቅድመ ፡
                  ገጽከ ፤ አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ እዋኅዮሙ ፡ ኣገብእ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ ።
verses.translation: And now go, descend, and lead this people into the place of which I spoke to thee: behold, my angel shall go before thy face; and in the day when I shall visit I will bring upon them their sin.

translations.lxx: And now go, descend, and lead this people into the place of which I spoke to thee: behold, my angel shall go before thy face; and in the day when I shall visit I will bring upon them their sin.
translations.kjv: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
translations.ron: Iar acum mergi şi du poporul acesta la locul unde ţi-am zis. Iată îngerul Meu va merge înaintea ta şi în ziua cercetării Mele voi pedepsi păcatul lor".
translations.grk: Νυνὶ δὲ βάδιζε, κατάβηθι, καὶ ὁδήγησον τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον εἰς τὸν τόπον, ὃν εἶπά σοι· ἰδοὺ ὁ ἄγγελός μου προπορεύσεται πρὸ προσώπου σου· ᾖ δʼ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπισκέπτωμαι, ἐπάξω ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν αὐτῶν

verses.geez: ወቀተለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምሕዝብ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘገብሩ ፡ ላህመ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ አሮን ።
verses.translation: And the Lord smote the people for the making of the calf, which Aaron made.

translations.lxx: And the Lord smote the people for the making of the calf, which Aaron made.
translations.kjv: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
translations.ron: Astfel a lovit Domnul poporul, pentru viţelul ce îşi făcuse, pe care-l turnase Aaron.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπάταξε Κύριος τὸν λαὸν περὶ τῆς ποιήσεως τοῦ μόσχου, οὗ ἐποίησεν Ἀαρών.
